name: Esports Foundation (formerly Esports World Cup Foundation)
note: Riyadh-based non-profit; claims it is not owned or operated by the Saudi government but funded through a PIF sports grant (The Esports Advocate, 2025-09-03). The Saudi cabinet named Crown Prince MBS chair of its board of trustees on 2 Sep 2025, and the crown prince announced the foundation itself in 2023, so the state link is direct.
